title: Spot the Symmetry · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Spot the Symmetry · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner draws two simple shapes, one with a clear line of symmetry and one without. The lead points to the symmetric shape and indicates a line that divides it into matching halves. The selected shape and line match the drawing. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Spot the Symmetry, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The selected shape and line match the drawing.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The selected shape and line match the drawing.
